repairedFindings.finding: Per-created-chip listeners retained removed chip references until teardown.
repairedFindings.evidence: Source review; no heap or red-before runtime measurement.
repairedFindings.repair: Delegate one chip listener and retain only active chip nodes.

repairedFindings.finding: Focus fallback used insertion order rather than actual chip DOM order.
repairedFindings.evidence: Source review with a passing inverse-selection-order regression; no red-before claim.
repairedFindings.repair: Maintain the current bounded DOM order.

repairedFindings.finding: Older async page recovery could cancel a newer composition draft.
repairedFindings.evidence: Source review; held actual out-of-range native query/recovery regression passes.
repairedFindings.repair: Distinguish recovery snapshots from newer external commands.

repairedFindings.finding: WebKit pointer activation could remove a chip without focus, or close filters to BODY.
repairedFindings.evidence: Actual failing installed WebKit assertions and native control pointer-focus baseline are retained.
repairedFindings.repair: Track the activated chip as a logical focus opener; explicit close always restores summary focus. Persistent controls retain native pointer policy and use actual keyboard activation in focus-retention assertions.

repairedFindings.finding: Document-only active focus missed an explicitly supplied closed shadow root.
repairedFindings.evidence: Source review and actual known closed-root focus/teardown regression.
repairedFindings.repair: Read only the supplied root tree activeElement, without global opaque-tree discovery.

repairedFindings.finding: A raw whitespace/control-only choice could lack a readable label.
repairedFindings.evidence: Source review and bounded admission/refusal plus explicit-label success regression.
repairedFindings.repair: Require an explicit readable label for a nonempty invisible value.

repairedFindings.finding: New gallery component lacked both explicit Astro compilation registrations and was treated as Markdown.
repairedFindings.evidence: Actual before-fix gallery timeout/404 and diagnostic rendered source; repaired gallery passes exact source/archive/preview checks.
repairedFindings.repair: Register the component in both allowlists and fail closed for an unhandled Astro page.

visualReview: Actual installed desktop and 320px RTL/dark screenshots inspected; no material visual issue identified.
Emulated media/reflow and selected axe are separate from real zoom, physical input or human AT.
limits: No human AT/speech, physical IME/touch/mobile keyboard, actual 200/400% browser zoom, Safari/device or remote/hosted/release qualification.
Native pagehide/persisted-pageshow events are scripted lifecycle probes; Back/Forward traversal itself is actual.
History refusal is injected; it is not a native quota/security-refusal observation.
